extensionDescription.message: Cleans cookies and local storage from Firefox containers.

loadContainers.description: Status message when the extension is loading the container list.

rangeLabel.description: Label for the time range selector.

rangeOneHour.description: Set the time range to the previous hour.

rangeTwoHours.description: Set the time range to the previous 2 hours.

rangeFourHours.description: Set the time range to the previous 2 hours.

rangeSinceMidnight.description: Set the time range to since midnight.

rangeUnlimited.description: Set the time range to unlimited.

clearConfirm.description: Status message when a further confirmation is requested to clear data.

clearProgress.description: Status message when a clear operation is in progress.

clearDone.description: Status message when a clear is complete.
